title: Detect the node addresses
description: Probe the addresses mediasoup can bind and announce

public_address.title: Public IP address
public_address.description: The node's own address when it is globally routable, otherwise what an echo service reports. Empty when the probe failed.

private_address.title: LAN IP address
private_address.description: Source address the kernel would use to reach the internet. Empty when the routing table could not be read.
